observations.body: The scene includes confession, secrecy, and suffering. It also includes Peter’s objection, Jesus’ rebuke, and the gathered crowd. It also includes the cross and shame. Together, these details form Mark’s transition.

payload.tension: The passage states the scene includes confession, secrecy, and suffering. It also includes Peter’s objection, Jesus’ rebuke, and the gathered crowd. It also includes the cross and shame. Together, these details form Mark’s transition. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Satan's story.
